architecture.firestoreOwnership: Firestore remains canonical for user/app state, profiles, ContextCapsules, context stacks, conversations, documents, and output capsules.
architecture.cloudSqlOwnership: Cloud SQL Postgres is the durable ledger for Ask SQL memory and agent runs: ask_threads, ask_thread_turns, agent_runs, agent_run_events, agent_tool_calls, and agent_approvals.
architecture.executionSubstrates: ADK, Genkit, Vertex, Gemini, Cloud Tasks, and Cloud Run execute work but do not become the product source of truth.

findings.summary: Cloud Tasks worker authentication is not configured.
evidence: Cloud Run service account hint: not visible in env
findings.affectedFlow: Durable queued agent dispatch and worker execution.
remediation: Set AGENT_RUN_WORKER_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL and AGENT_RUN_WORKER_OIDC_AUDIENCE for OIDC worker auth.
Use AGENT_RUN_WORKER_SHARED_SECRET only as a documented fallback.

findings.summary: Vertex project is missing and no Google AI fallback is visible.
findings.affectedFlow: Ask model selection, Gemini runtime routing, and queued agent execution.
remediation: Keep Google AI fallback configured only as a controlled fallback, not the canonical production posture.

findings.summary: Continuity check maps ownerUid, capsuleId, threadId, and traceId across Firestore and Cloud SQL.
findings.affectedFlow: User asks a capsule, continues a conversation, queues a deep agent run, and reads the resulting receipt.
remediation: Ensure Ask requests persist capsuleId/threadId in Firestore and SQL.
Ensure agent_runs carries owner_uid, capsule_id, context_package_id, and trace_id.

findings.summary: Firebase Admin credentials are not visible to the diagnostic environment.
evidence: Cloud Run service account hint: not visible in env
findings.affectedFlow: Profile, ContextCapsule, conversation, and output-capsule reads.
remediation: Run npm run auth:doctor and configure FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY_FILE, FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY, or ADC.

Rerun npm run audit:runtime-data-plane after the secret is mounted.

findings.summary: Database ownership is explicit: Firestore owns user/app/capsule state; Cloud SQL owns Ask SQL memory and agent-run ledgers; PRAXIS remains canonical over execution substrates.
evidence: Firestore path inventory includes profiles, capsules, context stacks, conversations, documents, and output capsules.
Cloud SQL schema inventory includes Ask thread tables and agent runtime tables.
Ask PRAXIS model policy provider: vertex
remediation: Do not introduce a replacement database owner without updating the architecture docs and migration plan.

findings.summary: Write canary mode is disabled; this diagnostic is read-only.
remediation: Set PRAXIS_DIAGNOSTIC_WRITE_CANARY=1 only for an explicit controlled canary phase.
